newsitem.title: MEXICO: Aeromexico sees revenues up 15 pct in '97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Aeromexico sees revenues up 15 pct in '97 - paper.

text.p: Aerovias de Mexico (Aeromexico), a unit of the airline holding Cintra SA de CV, expects to see revenues rise 15 percent in 1997 over levels recorded last year, the daily Siglo 21 said Wednesday.
Citing commerical director Jose Manuel Diaz de Rivera, the Guadalajara-based daily said Aeromexico expects revenues to rise to around one billion pesos from the 850 million in 1996.
Diaz de Rivera said the sales increase would come because of the strength of the airline's alliances with other companies and because of new flight routes incorporated this year.
